name: high_rom_120_120_research_only

controller_completion_margin.source_evidence: goal_mpc_complete_v1/attempt_05_final exact phase-transition estimator-minus-truth errors plus a small deterministic guard

status_note: Provisional Stage-5 engineering limits only; not hardware- or clinically calibrated. They constrain each joint independently and do not define a trajectory, coordination ratio, or path corridor. The controller completion margin only tightens online decisions; the original 1 deg and 2 deg/s tolerances remain the actual task definition.
rom_rationale: 125 deg is the minimum 5 deg soft-limit-offset hard bound that places the 120 deg goal at the original soft-limit onset. It is a simulation research hypothesis, not a measured human hard limit.
